all_blocks.heading: Principle 1: Block Entry Errors, Not Business Decisions
all_blocks.label: Low Citability
all_blocks.preview: Good: Blocking invalid email formats Bad: Blocking opportunities under $10,000 Validation rules prevent data entry errors. They shouldn't enforce business policies that have legitimate exceptions.

all_blocks.heading: Principle 2: Explain the Fix, Not Just the Problem
all_blocks.label: Poor Citability
all_blocks.preview: Bad message: "Invalid phone number" Good message: "Phone number must be exactly 10 digits (e.g., 5551234567)" Users should know exactly how to fix the error.
